headline: Last session: Sensex plunges 989 points, Nifty slips below 25,650 as IT stocks drag

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Bears took charge in the last session as Sensex tumbled 989 points.
Nifty slipped below 25,650 dragged by sharp selling in IT stocks and HDFC Bank.
Mutual funds have sold Rs 32,740 crore worth of equities so far in November.
RBI stepped up scrutiny on gold loans due to borrower stress signaled by bullion rout.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed 989 points while Nifty closed near 25,600 in the last trading session.
IT sector stocks and HDFC Bank heavily dragged benchmark indices downward.
Jaiprakash Power Ventures and CarTrade Tech plunged sharply over the year despite mutual funds raising stakes.
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 30 November.
summary:
In the last trading session on Friday, Indian equities tumbled sharply as the Sensex sank 989 points and Nifty fell below 25,650, heavily dragged by IT stocks and HDFC Bank.
Institutional data showed mutual funds sold over Rs 32,740 crore in equities during November while smallcaps like Jaiprakash Power Ventures and CarTrade Tech saw heavy yearly declines.
The stock market is closed today due to the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, 30 November.
